type finalReviewCatalogStub struct {
	runtime    domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext
	evaluation domain.PracticeTaskEvaluationContext
}

func (stub finalReviewCatalogStub) GetRuntimeContext(context.Context, string) (*domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext, error) {
	copy := stub.runtime
	return &copy, nil
}

func (stub finalReviewCatalogStub) GetPublishedRuntimeContext(context.Context, string) (*domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext, error) {
	copy := stub.runtime
	return &copy, nil
}

func (stub finalReviewCatalogStub) GetRevisionRuntimeContext(context.Context, string) (*domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext, error) {
	copy := stub.runtime
	return &copy, nil
}

func (stub finalReviewCatalogStub) GetRevisionEvaluationContext(context.Context, string) (*domain.PracticeTaskEvaluationContext, error) {
	copy := stub.evaluation
	return &copy, nil
}

type finalReviewRepositoryStub struct {
	repository.StudentPracticeTaskRepository
	project    domain.StudentPracticeTask
	milestones []domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone
	artifacts  []domain.StudentPracticeTaskArtifact
	reviews    []domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview
}

func (stub *finalReviewRepositoryStub) GetStudentPracticeTask(context.Context, string) (*domain.StudentPracticeTask, error) {
	copy := stub.project
	return &copy, nil
}

func (stub *finalReviewRepositoryStub) UpdateStudentPracticeTask(_ context.Context, project domain.StudentPracticeTask) error {
	stub.project = project
	return nil
}

func (stub *finalReviewRepositoryStub) ListStudentPracticeTaskMilestones(context.Context, string) ([]domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone, error) {
	return append([]domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone(nil), stub.milestones...), nil
}

func (stub *finalReviewRepositoryStub) UpdateStudentPracticeTaskMilestone(_ context.Context, milestone domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone) error {
	for index := range stub.milestones {
		if stub.milestones[index].ID == milestone.ID {
			stub.milestones[index] = milestone
			return nil
		}
	}
	return domain.ErrNotFound
}

func (stub *finalReviewRepositoryStub) ListArtifacts(context.Context, string) ([]domain.StudentPracticeTaskArtifact, error) {
	return append([]domain.StudentPracticeTaskArtifact(nil), stub.artifacts...), nil
}

func (stub *finalReviewRepositoryStub) ListFinalReviews(context.Context, string) ([]domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview, error) {
	return append([]domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview(nil), stub.reviews...), nil
}

func (stub *finalReviewRepositoryStub) CreateFinalReview(_ context.Context, review domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview) (*domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview, error) {
	review.SubmissionNumber = len(stub.reviews) + 1
	stub.reviews = append(stub.reviews, review)
	copy := review
	return &copy, nil
}

func (stub *finalReviewRepositoryStub) UpdateFinalReview(_ context.Context, review domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview) error {
	for index := range stub.reviews {
		if stub.reviews[index].ID == review.ID {
			stub.reviews[index] = review
			return nil
		}
	}
	return domain.ErrNotFound
}

func (stub *finalReviewRepositoryStub) GetFinalReview(_ context.Context, reviewID string) (*domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview, error) {
	for _, review := range stub.reviews {
		if review.ID == reviewID {
			copy := review
			return &copy, nil
		}
	}
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}

func (stub *finalReviewRepositoryStub) ListPendingFinalReviews(context.Context, int, int) ([]domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview, error) {
	return append([]domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview(nil), stub.reviews...), nil
}

	stub.answer = answer

	return nil, errors.New("unexpected sandbox create")

	return errors.New("unexpected sandbox write")

	return append([]domain.WorkspaceFile(nil), stub.files...), nil

type finalReviewAIStub struct {
	result json.RawMessage
	calls  int
}

type finalReviewValidationStub struct {
	passed   bool
	calls    int
	requests []domain.ValidationRunRequest
}

func (stub *finalReviewValidationStub) Validate(_ context.Context, request domain.ValidationRunRequest) (*domain.ValidationRunResult, error) {
	stub.calls++
	stub.requests = append(stub.requests, request)
	return &domain.ValidationRunResult{
		ContractKind:    "workspace_contract",
		ContractVersion: 1,
		Passed:          stub.passed,
	}, nil
}

func (stub *finalReviewAIStub) Execute(context.Context, PracticeTaskAIReviewRequest) (json.RawMessage, error) {
	stub.calls++
	return stub.result, nil
}

func TestSubmitPracticeTaskFinalReviewFallsBackToMentorWhenAIUnavailable(t *testing.T) {
	useCase, repositoryStub := newFinalReviewTestUseCase(nil)
	review, err := useCase.SubmitPracticeTaskFinalReview(context.Background(), "student-1", "student-project-1")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("submit final review: %v", err)
	}
	if review.Status != domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusPendingMentor || review.AIStatus != domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewStatusUnavailable {
		t.Fatalf("expected mentor fallback after unavailable AI, got %#v", review)
	}
	if repositoryStub.project.Status != domain.StudentPracticeTaskStatusInReview || repositoryStub.project.CompletedAt != nil {
		t.Fatalf("project must wait for mentor review, got %#v", repositoryStub.project)
	}
}

func TestSubmitPracticeTaskFinalReviewKeepsAIResultAdvisoryUntilMentorDecision(t *testing.T) {
	ai := &finalReviewAIStub{result: json.RawMessage(`{"decision":"changes_requested","summary":"Architecture can be improved","findings":[],"evidence":[]}`)}
	useCase, repositoryStub := newFinalReviewTestUseCase(ai)
	review, err := useCase.SubmitPracticeTaskFinalReview(context.Background(), "student-1", "student-project-1")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("submit final review: %v", err)
	}
	if ai.calls != 1 || review.AIStatus != domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewStatusCompleted || review.Status != domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusPendingMentor {
		t.Fatalf("expected completed advisory AI review and pending mentor, got %#v", review)
	}
	if repositoryStub.project.Status != domain.StudentPracticeTaskStatusInReview {
		t.Fatalf("AI must not reject or complete a mentor-reviewed project, got %#v", repositoryStub.project)
	}
}

func TestSubmitPracticeTaskFinalReviewRerunsPinnedDeterministicContracts(t *testing.T) {
	useCase, repositoryStub := newFinalReviewTestUseCase(nil)
	validation := useCase.Validation.(*finalReviewValidationStub)
	review, err := useCase.SubmitPracticeTaskFinalReview(context.Background(), "student-1", "student-project-1")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("submit final review: %v", err)
	}
	if validation.calls != 1 || len(validation.requests) != 1 || validation.requests[0].Mode != "final" {
		t.Fatalf("expected one final validation call against the pinned milestone, got %#v", validation.requests)
	}
	if len(validation.requests[0].WorkspaceFiles) != 1 || validation.requests[0].WorkspaceFiles[0].Path != "index.html" {
		t.Fatalf("expected current sandbox snapshot in final validation, got %#v", validation.requests[0].WorkspaceFiles)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(string(review.DeterministicReportJSON), `"integration_bundle_present":true`) {
		t.Fatalf("expected final validation evidence in deterministic report, got %s", review.DeterministicReportJSON)
	}
	if len(repositoryStub.reviews) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected review only after deterministic pass, got %#v", repositoryStub.reviews)
	}
}

func TestSubmitPracticeTaskFinalReviewPinsArtifactFromFinalMilestoneAnswer(t *testing.T) {
	useCase, repositoryStub := newFinalReviewTestUseCase(nil)
	repositoryStub.artifacts = []domain.StudentPracticeTaskArtifact{
		{
			ID:                    "newer-unrelated-artifact",
			StudentPracticeTaskID: repositoryStub.project.ID,
			StorageFileID:         "unrelated-storage",
			MetaJSON:              json.RawMessage(`{"task_answer_id":"another-answer"}`),
			CreatedAt:             time.Now().UTC().Add(time.Minute),
		},
		repositoryStub.artifacts[0],
	}

	review, err := useCase.SubmitPracticeTaskFinalReview(context.Background(), "student-1", "student-project-1")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("submit final review: %v", err)
	}
	if review.ArtifactID == nil || *review.ArtifactID != "artifact-1" {
		t.Fatalf("expected artifact from final milestone answer, got %#v", review.ArtifactID)
	}
}

func TestStorefrontFinalReviewRerunsEveryMilestoneInSelectedProgressiveVariant(t *testing.T) {
	useCase, repositoryStub := newFinalReviewTestUseCase(nil)
	catalog := useCase.Catalog.(finalReviewCatalogStub)
	base := catalog.runtime.PracticeTaskMilestones[0]
	catalog.runtime.PracticeTaskMilestones = []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{
		base,
		cloneFinalReviewMilestone(base, "runtime-milestone-2", 2),
		cloneFinalReviewMilestone(base, "runtime-milestone-3", 3),
	}
	catalog.runtime.SolutionVariants[0].MilestoneIDs = []string{"runtime-milestone-1", "runtime-milestone-2", "runtime-milestone-3"}
	useCase.Catalog = catalog
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	answerID := "answer-2"
	repositoryStub.milestones = append(repositoryStub.milestones,
		domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone{ID: "student-milestone-2", StudentPracticeTaskID: repositoryStub.project.ID, PracticeTaskPartMilestoneID: "runtime-milestone-2", Status: domain.StudentMilestoneStatusPassed, TaskAnswerID: &answerID, BestResultJSON: json.RawMessage(`{"passed":true}`), PassedAt: &now},
		domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone{ID: "student-milestone-3", StudentPracticeTaskID: repositoryStub.project.ID, PracticeTaskPartMilestoneID: "runtime-milestone-3", Status: domain.StudentMilestoneStatusPassed, TaskAnswerID: &answerID, BestResultJSON: json.RawMessage(`{"passed":true}`), PassedAt: &now},
	)
	repositoryStub.artifacts = append([]domain.StudentPracticeTaskArtifact{{
		ID:                    "artifact-2",
		StudentPracticeTaskID: repositoryStub.project.ID,
		StorageFileID:         "storage-2",
		MetaJSON:              json.RawMessage(`{"task_answer_id":"answer-2"}`),
		CreatedAt:             now,
	}}, repositoryStub.artifacts...)
	validation := useCase.Validation.(*finalReviewValidationStub)
	_, err := useCase.SubmitPracticeTaskFinalReview(context.Background(), "student-1", "student-project-1")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("submit progressive storefront final review: %v", err)
	}
	if validation.calls != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("expected every selected progressive milestone to be revalidated, got %d calls", validation.calls)
	}
}

func cloneFinalReviewMilestone(base domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone, id string, order int) domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone {
	base.ID = id
	base.SortOrder = order
	return base
}

func TestSubmitPracticeTaskFinalReviewStopsBeforeAIAndMentorWhenFinalValidationFails(t *testing.T) {
	ai := &finalReviewAIStub{result: json.RawMessage(`{"decision":"pass","summary":"ok","findings":[],"evidence":[]}`)}
	useCase, repositoryStub := newFinalReviewTestUseCase(ai)
	useCase.Validation = &finalReviewValidationStub{passed: false}
	_, err := useCase.SubmitPracticeTaskFinalReview(context.Background(), "student-1", "student-project-1")
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("expected final deterministic failure, got %v", err)
	}
	if len(repositoryStub.reviews) != 0 || ai.calls != 0 || repositoryStub.project.Status != domain.StudentPracticeTaskStatusReadyForReview {
		t.Fatalf("failed final validation must not enter review, got reviews=%d ai=%d project=%#v", len(repositoryStub.reviews), ai.calls, repositoryStub.project)
	}
}

func TestMentorChangesRequestReopensFinalMilestoneAndAnswer(t *testing.T) {
	useCase, repositoryStub := newFinalReviewTestUseCase(nil)
	review, err := useCase.SubmitPracticeTaskFinalReview(context.Background(), "student-1", "student-project-1")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("submit final review: %v", err)
	}
	answers := &finalReviewAnswerRepositoryStub{answer: domain.StudentTaskAnswer{ID: "answer-1", Status: domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusPassed}}
	useCase.Answers = answers
	feedback := "Please fix the checkout behavior"
	updated, err := useCase.ReviewPracticeTaskFinalSubmission(context.Background(), "reviewer-1", "student-project-1", review.ID, PracticeTaskMentorDecision{
		Passed:   false,
		Feedback: &feedback,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("request changes: %v", err)
	}
	if updated.Status != domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusChangesRequested || repositoryStub.project.Status != domain.StudentPracticeTaskStatusChangesRequested {
		t.Fatalf("expected changes-requested state, got review=%#v project=%#v", updated, repositoryStub.project)
	}
	if repositoryStub.milestones[0].Status != domain.StudentMilestoneStatusFailed || answers.answer.Status != domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusRejected {
		t.Fatalf("final milestone and answer must be reopened, got milestone=%#v answer=%#v", repositoryStub.milestones[0], answers.answer)
	}
}

func TestDeterministicCompletionWaitsForConfiguredFinalReview(t *testing.T) {
	useCase, repositoryStub := newFinalReviewTestUseCase(nil)
	repositoryStub.project.Status = domain.StudentPracticeTaskStatusActive
	if err := useCase.advanceProjectAfterRuntimePass(context.Background(), &repositoryStub.project, "student-milestone-1", time.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("advance project: %v", err)
	}
	if repositoryStub.project.Status != domain.StudentPracticeTaskStatusReadyForReview || repositoryStub.project.CompletedAt != nil {
		t.Fatalf("configured review must keep project incomplete and ready for submission, got %#v", repositoryStub.project)
	}
}

func TestLegacyDeterministicCompletionStillCompletesImmediately(t *testing.T) {
	useCase, repositoryStub := newFinalReviewTestUseCase(nil)
	repositoryStub.project.Status = domain.StudentPracticeTaskStatusActive
	catalog := useCase.Catalog.(finalReviewCatalogStub)
	catalog.runtime.SolutionVariants[0].ReviewPolicyJSON = json.RawMessage(`{}`)
	useCase.Catalog = catalog
	if err := useCase.advanceProjectAfterRuntimePass(context.Background(), &repositoryStub.project, "student-milestone-1", time.Now().UTC()); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("advance legacy project: %v", err)
	}
	if repositoryStub.project.Status != domain.StudentPracticeTaskStatusCompleted || repositoryStub.project.CompletedAt == nil {
		t.Fatalf("legacy project without review policy must remain backward compatible, got %#v", repositoryStub.project)
	}
}

func TestReviewPolicyRequiresMentorInStudentBoundary(t *testing.T) {
	_, _, err := parsePracticeTaskReviewPolicy(json.RawMessage(`{"version":1,"ai_review":{"mode":"disabled"},"mentor_review":{"mode":"disabled"}}`))
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("expected mentor-required policy validation, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestReviewerQueueIncludesPinnedMentorRubric(t *testing.T) {
	useCase, repositoryStub := newFinalReviewTestUseCase(nil)
	repositoryStub.reviews = []domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview{{
		ID:                    "review-1",
		StudentPracticeTaskID: "student-project-1",
		Status:                domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusPendingMentor,
	}}
	catalog := useCase.Catalog.(finalReviewCatalogStub)
	catalog.evaluation.Variants[0].MentorRubricJSON = json.RawMessage(`{"version":1,"code":"mentor-v1","criteria":["behavior"]}`)
	useCase.Catalog = catalog
	items, err := useCase.ListPendingPracticeTaskFinalReviews(context.Background(), 50, 0)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("list reviewer queue: %v", err)
	}
	if len(items) != 1 || string(items[0].MentorRubricJSON) != `{"version":1,"code":"mentor-v1","criteria":["behavior"]}` || items[0].Task.VariantCode != "html-css-js" {
		t.Fatalf("expected pinned mentor rubric in reviewer queue, got %#v", items)
	}
}

func TestReviewerDetailReturnsSanitizedImmutableArtifact(t *testing.T) {
	useCase, repositoryStub := newFinalReviewTestUseCase(nil)
	artifactID := "artifact-1"
	repositoryStub.reviews = []domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview{{
		ID:                    "review-1",
		StudentPracticeTaskID: "student-project-1",
		ArtifactID:            &artifactID,
		Status:                domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusPendingMentor,
	}}
	repositoryStub.artifacts[0].StorageFileID = "approved-artifact-file"
	useCase.PublicationFiles = &publicationFileStorageStub{source: publicationTestZip(t, map[string]string{
		"index.html":                "<h1>Marketplace</h1>",
		"src/app.js":                "console.log('ready')",
		"node_modules/pkg/index.js": "must not be returned",
		".env":                      "PASSWORD=must-not-leak",
	})}

	detail, err := useCase.GetPracticeTaskFinalReviewForReviewer(context.Background(), "student-project-1", "review-1")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("get reviewer detail: %v", err)
	}
	if detail.Task.Title != "Marketplace" || len(detail.Files) != 2 || len(detail.ExcludedPaths) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("expected task context and sanitized immutable files, got %#v", detail)
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(detail)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("marshal reviewer detail: %v", err)
	}
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"approved-artifact-file", "must-not-leak"} {
		if strings.Contains(string(encoded), forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("reviewer detail leaked %q: %s", forbidden, encoded)
		}
	}
}

func TestRetryPracticeTaskAIReviewMovesRecoveredReviewToMentor(t *testing.T) {
	ai := &finalReviewAIStub{result: json.RawMessage(`{"decision":"pass","summary":"Requirements are met","findings":[],"evidence":[]}`)}
	useCase, repositoryStub := newFinalReviewTestUseCase(ai)
	repositoryStub.project.Status = domain.StudentPracticeTaskStatusInReview
	repositoryStub.reviews = []domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview{{
		ID:                             "review-1",
		StudentPracticeTaskID:          "student-project-1",
		StudentPracticeTaskMilestoneID: "student-milestone-1",
		TaskAnswerID:                   "answer-1",
		Status:                         domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusBlockedAI,
		AIStatus:                       domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewStatusUnavailable,
		AIResultJSON:                   json.RawMessage(`{}`),
		DeterministicReportJSON:        json.RawMessage(`{"milestones":[]}`),
	}}
	review, err := useCase.RetryPracticeTaskAIReview(context.Background(), "student-project-1", "review-1")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("retry AI review: %v", err)
	}
	if ai.calls != 1 || review.AIStatus != domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewStatusCompleted || review.Status != domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusPendingMentor {
		t.Fatalf("expected recovered review to continue to mentor, got %#v", review)
	}
}

func TestRetryPracticeTaskAIReviewAllowsPendingMentorFallback(t *testing.T) {
	ai := &finalReviewAIStub{result: json.RawMessage(`{"decision":"pass","summary":"Requirements are met","findings":[],"evidence":[]}`)}
	useCase, repositoryStub := newFinalReviewTestUseCase(ai)
	repositoryStub.project.Status = domain.StudentPracticeTaskStatusInReview
	repositoryStub.reviews = []domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview{{
		ID:                             "review-1",
		StudentPracticeTaskID:          "student-project-1",
		StudentPracticeTaskMilestoneID: "student-milestone-1",
		TaskAnswerID:                   "answer-1",
		Status:                         domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusPendingMentor,
		AIStatus:                       domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewStatusUnavailable,
		MentorStatus:                   domain.PracticeTaskMentorReviewStatusPending,
		AIResultJSON:                   json.RawMessage(`{}`),
		DeterministicReportJSON:        json.RawMessage(`{"milestones":[]}`),
	}}

	review, err := useCase.RetryPracticeTaskAIReview(context.Background(), "student-project-1", "review-1")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("retry mentor-only fallback AI review: %v", err)
	}
	if ai.calls != 1 || review.AIStatus != domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewStatusCompleted || review.Status != domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusPendingMentor {
		t.Fatalf("expected mentor-only fallback retry to recover, got %#v", review)
	}
}

func TestRetryPracticeTaskAIReviewRejectsDecidedMentorReview(t *testing.T) {
	useCase, repositoryStub := newFinalReviewTestUseCase(&finalReviewAIStub{})
	repositoryStub.reviews = []domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview{{
		ID:                    "review-1",
		StudentPracticeTaskID: "student-project-1",
		Status:                domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusPendingMentor,
		AIStatus:              domain.PracticeTaskAIReviewStatusUnavailable,
		MentorStatus:          domain.PracticeTaskMentorReviewStatusPassed,
	}}

	_, err := useCase.RetryPracticeTaskAIReview(context.Background(), "student-project-1", "review-1")
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidStatus) {
		t.Fatalf("expected decided mentor review to reject AI retry, got %v", err)
	}
}

func newFinalReviewTestUseCase(ai PracticeTaskAIReviewClient) (StudentUseCase, *finalReviewRepositoryStub) {
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	answerID := "answer-1"
	sandboxID := "sandbox-1"
	policy := json.RawMessage(`{"version":1,"ai_review":{"mode":"optional","on_unavailable":"mentor_only","max_input_bytes":200000},"mentor_review":{"mode":"required"}}`)
	contract := json.RawMessage(`{"version":1,"template_code":"practice_task.solution_review.v1","language_code":"en","response_schema_code":"practice_task.review.v1","rubric_version":"test-v1","what_to_check":["requirements"],"what_not_to_check":["reference structure"],"allowed_variations":["equivalent solutions"],"uncertain_when":["insufficient evidence"]}`)
	runtime := domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext{
		RevisionID:     "revision-1",
		RevisionNumber: 1,
		PracticeTask: domain.PracticeTask{
			ID:    "practice-task-1",
			Title: "Marketplace",
			Theme: "Commerce",
		},
		SolutionVariants: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeVariant{{
			ID:               "variant-1",
			Code:             "html-css-js",
			Title:            "HTML + CSS + JavaScript",
			Topology:         "frontend_only",
			StackCodes:       []string{"html", "css", "javascript"},
			ReviewPolicyJSON: policy,
			MilestoneIDs:     []string{"runtime-milestone-1"},
			IsActive:         true,
		}},
		PracticeTaskMilestones: []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{{
			ID:                     "runtime-milestone-1",
			PartSortOrder:          1,
			SortOrder:              1,
			PracticeTaskPartID:     "part-1",
			IsActive:               true,
			ValidationContractJSON: json.RawMessage(`{"version":1,"kind":"workspace_contract","stages":[{"id":"final","engine":"html.dom","mode":"both"}]}`),
			RuntimeProfileJSON:     json.RawMessage(`{"code_structure_type_code":"HTML_BASIC_DOCUMENT","compose_config":{"services":{"web":{"image":"nginx"}}}}`),
		}},
	}
	repositoryStub := &finalReviewRepositoryStub{
		project: domain.StudentPracticeTask{
			ID:                            "student-project-1",
			StudentID:                     "student-1",
			PracticeTaskID:                "practice-task-1",
			PracticeTaskRevisionID:        "revision-1",
			PracticeTaskSolutionVariantID: "variant-1",
			Status:                        domain.StudentPracticeTaskStatusReadyForReview,
			ActiveSandboxID:               &sandboxID,
		},
		milestones: []domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone{{
			ID:                          "student-milestone-1",
			StudentPracticeTaskID:       "student-project-1",
			PracticeTaskPartMilestoneID: "runtime-milestone-1",
			Status:                      domain.StudentMilestoneStatusPassed,
			TaskAnswerID:                &answerID,
			BestResultJSON:              json.RawMessage(`{"passed":true}`),
			PassedAt:                    &now,
		}},
		artifacts: []domain.StudentPracticeTaskArtifact{{
			ID:                    "artifact-1",
			StudentPracticeTaskID: "student-project-1",
			StorageFileID:         "storage-1",
			MetaJSON:              json.RawMessage(`{"task_answer_id":"answer-1"}`),
			CreatedAt:             now,
		}},
	}
	return StudentUseCase{
		Catalog: finalReviewCatalogStub{
			runtime: runtime,
			evaluation: domain.PracticeTaskEvaluationContext{Variants: []domain.PracticeTaskVariantEvaluation{{
				PracticeTaskSolutionVariantID:   "variant-1",
				AIReviewContractJSON:            contract,
				IntegrationTestSuiteRef:         stringPointer("private/tests/final.mjs"),
				IntegrationReferenceSolutionRef: stringPointer("private/reference/final"),
